findings.body: This test signs in through the test-auth endpoint, then checks one successful onboarding submission. It never exercises the Google callback, invalid names or WhatsApp numbers, a valid number from another country, a changed Google email, or two simultaneous submissions. Those required behaviours therefore lack the specified browser flow through the running API and real database.
findings.title: Not done: apps/web/e2e/onboarding.spec.ts

findings.body: The test calls test-auth instead of following the Google start and callback flow, and opens `/not-open-yet` directly instead of checking the sign-in redirect. Its final 401 check proves that the session ended, but not that the pending record was erased. It also leaves the no-storage rejection, changed-email return, 30-day cleanup and return path through Google sign-in untested by the required end-to-end flow.

findings.body: The required source test files are absent from this new web app. The configured Playwright suite searches only `./e2e`, so a source test would not run in the repository's current web test suite even if added.
